args.title: checkout-api failing health checks; rolled back to v2.2.9
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all production regions (error rate 0.18). Rolled back to v2.2.9 (the most recent healthy production release; v2.3.0 was quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417). Rollback verified in us-east, us-west, and eu-west.

trace.final:
I rolled back checkout-api and opened an incident.

**What I did:**
1. Confirmed checkout-api was unhealthy on `v2.3.1` in all three production regions (error rate 0.18).
2. Attempted rollback to `v2.3.0` (the most recent healthy production release), but it was rejected — `v2.3.0` is quarantined due to CVE-2026-4417.
3. Rolled back to `v2.2.9`, the next most recent healthy production release. Rollback verified across `us-east`, `us-west`, and `eu-west`.
4. Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** describing the failure and the rollback, paging on-call.

Note: `v2.3.0` being quarantined means the service is now on `v2.2.9`, which is two versions behind the failed deploy — worth flagging for the on-call engineer to confirm the CVE quarantine is expected and to plan a patched forward fix.
